name: Google Red Oak

timeline.event: Building 1 is operational, based on a Google Earth image showing a completed building shell and equipment, and the large construction car park being emptied. Building 2 shell looks mostly completed.

Building 1 appears active - the surrounding land is finished including the site entrance and the parking lot. The dry coolers for Building 2 are nearly complete although the building is still clearly a construction zone. The Building 2…
Building 2 is estimated to be operational.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Google Red Oak: current power 77 MW; owner Google.

explain: Google Red Oak is an operating AI data center in Red Oak, TX, owned by google. Epoch AI estimates it draws 77 MW today and 185 MW when finished.
